C-51.IntentSummary: Docs look for this release: tree + Recent/Pinned, Mermaid and content themed by the app theme, always-visible expand, Docs and macOS families. Implemented by ZCode agents in worktrees; the orchestrator reviews against spec/plan/graph/tests, proves new tests red on main, runs full gates and merges.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Tree matches canvas Main/DocsDark in every theme: line folder icon (open/closed), name, chevron right; nested guide lines; current file on a soft pill; folder switcher row at the top. Uses M-057 icons and the chrome font/accent tokens.

Markdown-only by default: the initial walk (Rust walk_and_emit_inner) and the watcher path apply the same rule; folders with no Markdown anywhere below are hidden and appear when a Markdown file is created inside. Settings › Files «Show all files» (off) restores everything (non-Markdown dimmed, not openable as today).

Tests: Rust walk filter (md-only, all, nested empty dirs); renderer tree model (hide/show folders as files come and go); e2e chromium + webkit: opened folder shows only .md, toggle shows all, creating an .md in an empty folder reveals it.

T-002.Title: Recent and Pinned sidebar sections (R-1a)

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Recent (existing recent list, up to 10, newest first) and Pinned (persisted list; pin/unpin from tree and tab context menus; drag to reorder) above the tree, each collapsible; missing files greyed with Remove; clicking opens the file. All strings in 10 locales.
Tests: store (pin/unpin/reorder/persist/missing), component, e2e both engines.

T-002.ReviewEvidence: T-001 + T-002, orchestrator review 2026-10-16. The filter lives in the renderer view (store/treeFilter.js), so «Show all files» is instant and the Rust walk is unchanged; the watcher now adds non-Markdown files too, so both paths agree. Review fixes: a pre-existing root-chevron bug (toggleRootDirectories stored !expanded as the collapsed flag — the root never collapsed; caught by the new test, also broken on main); e2e emit helper used an outer variable inside page.evaluate (every tree event was dropped), prefs snapshot called on the page object, strict-mode locators, the show-all assertion targeted a file inside a collapsed folder, the screenshots wrote into the repo's screenshots/ (now test outputPath) and the Ink shot was actually light (theme now switched via the title bar); unit tests missing the Pinia/setupTestPinia imports, a Playwright-only .first(), a stat mock rejecting with an Error instead of Tauri's structured object, an import-time window.electron read; tab context-menu tests needed Pinia (the menu reads the pinned store). Visual: the current-file pill is inset (it ran edge to edge) with the name kept aligned, the accent bar dropped (overlapped the icon), Recent/Pinned no longer repeat the pill, folder hover inset. Gates: vitest 286 files / 3880 passed; grace lint 0; Playwright chromium + webkit 406 passed (2 load timeouts passed on rerun); sidebar e2e 22/22 both engines. Red on main: the six new unit files fail; sidebar-tree-redesign.spec 11/11 fail. WebKit screenshots Paper + Ink.

T-005.ReviewEvidence: Orchestrator review 2026-10-16. Vega-Lite, flowchart.js, js-sequence and KaTeX follow the theme tokens and palette (contentTheme.js; chartPalette shared with Mermaid). T-006.ReviewEvidence: Orchestrator review 2026-10-16. Always-visible expand button on Mermaid, Vega-Lite, flowchart.js, sequence, PlantUML and tables (replaces the C-34 hover toolbar, which held only that button; Cmd/Ctrl+click still opens the viewer). Review fixes: the agent had broken the e2e table fixture (two delimiter cells for three columns, so no table rendered); focus restore after Esc now returns to the invoking expand button when it had focus (a re-render could leave a detached button; the Escape keydown also reached muya, which re-focused the container, so the focus is re-asserted on the next ticks), and the e2e accepts the engine difference (WebKit does not focus clicked buttons, so a mouse-opened viewer returns focus to the editor there); the last column resize hit zone sits inside the cell, the e2e now grabs it 2 px in. T-007.Notes: ZCode agent (worktree agent/c51-t7) implemented 2026-10-16; gates to be run by the orchestrator (agent has no shell). Four themes: docs/docs-dark (canvas Main/DocsDark — #FCFCFB/#161615 grounds, ink text #1F1F1F/#ECECEA, hairline borders #E4E4E1/#2C2C2A, neutral ink accent, neutral soft selection) and macos/macos-dark (canvas MacOS — #FFFFFF/#1E1E1E grounds, #1D1D1F/#F5F5F7 text, system greys #D1D1D6/#3A3A3C, accent #007AFF/#0A84FF with AA-safe linkColour variants #0066CC/#409CFF because the C-41 gate requires linkColor ≥ 4.5:1 — pure #007AFF on white is 4.0:1, #0A84FF on #1E1E1E only 4.57:1, so links use the darkened/lightened Apple-blue variants while --themeColor keeps the system blues), Finder-like sidebars #ECECEE/#252527. Every theme ships the full paper variable set (80 declarations = paper's 79 + --chartPalette) + a Prism companion per member. --chartPalette (comma-separated, mirrored by util/theme.js onto the root inline style) is the T-003 series hook: Docs #4F6BED/#10A37F/#D97706/#E11D48/#7C3AED/#0891B2/#EA580C/#DB2777 with brighter dark variants; macOS the Apple system colours (light #007AFF/#34C759/#FF9500/#FF3B30/#AF52DE/#30B0C7/#FFCC00/#FF2D55, dark #0A84FF/#30D158/#FF9F0A/#FF453A/#BF5AF2/#40C8E0/#FFD60A/#FF375F). The document rides the system UI font via a theme-scoped `.editor-wrapper { font-family: … !important }` (the preference's editor font is an inline style that a normal stylesheet rule cannot beat; code keeps the code font because the common sheet sets it on code/pre directly). New unit tests/renderer/util/theme-families-docs-macos.test.js (family model, registration + prism on disk, canvas pins, chart palette pins, system-font override, swatch source values, dark classification, migration passthrough, real CSS → root mirror → readActiveThemeTokens → buildMermaidThemeConfig pie1/git0/xyChart + signature, familyMemberForMode auto/light/dark, palette+menu source pins, 10 locales).
